- Mean linear Binder crossing: `0.261115`.
- Linear extrapolation of susceptibility peak locations versus `1/L`: `0.261164` with RMS residual `0.000013`.
- Susceptibility peak-height fit: `chi_abs,max ~ L^p`, `p = 1.450868`.
